title: Efficient extraction of high molecular weight dsDNA from bacteriophage
author: Mitchell G Hedges
materials: Optional (recommended): Quantify the extracted DNA using a 1x dsDNA High Sensitivity Kit and a sample volume of 2 µL . Following favourable quantification, load between 5 ng to 20 ng of phage DNA with a loading dye onto a 1% TAE agarose gel prepared with 1X SYBR Safe Stain and run at 100V for 01:00:00 to assess DNA quality. Ensure a ladder such as 1kb Extend DNA Ladder (NEB) is used and loaded at the same mass as the phage DNA sample for visualisation on a trans-UV system such as ChemiDoc

steps.title: Prepare digestion master mix
steps.instruction: Calculate 50 µL digestion mix per 450 µL lysate; thaw DNase I, 10× DNase buffer, and RNase A on ice; in a clean microcentrifuge tube combine 5 µL DNase I, 5 µL RNase A, and 40 µL 10× DNase I reaction buffer; gently pipette mix 5–10 times (do not vortex).

steps.title: Prepare kit wash buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare Buffer AW1 and Buffer AW2 by mixing each with 100 % molecular‑grade ethanol according to the DNEasy Blood & Tissue Kit manual.

steps.title: Add digestion mix to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the prepared Digestion Master Mix to 450 µL syringe‑filtered (0.22 µm) bacteriophage lysate in a 1.5 mL LoBind microtube; mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 min in a Thermomixer without shaking.

steps.title: Vortex and spin
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 15 s, then briefly spin down the contents.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 360 µL of 96–100 % ethanol to the tube and mix thoroughly by vortexing (or pipetting) to obtain a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: Add EDTA and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 0.5 M EDTA (final concentration >20 mM) to inactivate DNase, gently pipette mix, then incubate at 37 °C for 1 min.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate DNase
steps.instruction: Incubate at 80 °C for 15 min to heat‑inactivate DNase, then chill at 4 °C for 1 min; briefly spin down to collect condensation, taking care to avoid tube rupture.

steps.title: Proteinase K lysis
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL proteinase K and 180 µL Buffer ATL to the sample, vortex, and incubate at 56 °C for 15 min (total volume becomes 720 µL).

steps.title: Add Buffer AL
steps.instruction: Add 360 µL Buffer AL to the lysate mixture and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Split sample
steps.instruction: Aliquot 360 µL of the mixture into a second labelled microcentrifuge tube (splitting the sample for downstream steps).

steps.title: Incubate after split
steps.instruction: Incubate the split aliquot at 56 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Load onto spin column
steps.instruction: Pipette 600 µL of the phage lysate mixture onto a labelled silica‑membrane spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge column (first load)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column in its collection tube at 6000 × g for 1 min; discard the flow‑through (not compatible with bleach) and discard the collection tube to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Load remaining lysate
steps.instruction: Repeat the load and centrifuge steps until the entire lysate volume has passed through the column.

steps.title: Prepare column for washes
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new collection tube, discarding any used tubes and flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 (ethanol wash buffer) onto the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge after AW1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 min; discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Transfer to clean tube
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new clean collection tube; discard the flow‑through (do not mix with bleach) and discard the used tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 onto the column.

steps.title: Centrifuge high‑speed
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (16 000–20 000 × g) for 1 min.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through (compatible with bleach), return the column to the collection tube and centrifuge at maximum speed (16 000–20 000 × g) for 3 min to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the column in a labelled 1.5 mL LoBind tube; add 40 µL warmed (56 °C) Buffer AE directly onto the membrane, incubate 56 °C for 1 min, then centrifuge ≥6000 × g for 1 min to collect eluate.

steps.title: Re‑elute DNA
steps.instruction: Pipette the eluate back onto the membrane, incubate 56 °C for 1 min, and centrifuge ≥6000 × g for 1 min to obtain a second eluate.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluate containing phage DNA at 2–8 °C in a labelled tube for downstream QA/QC and whole‑genome sequencing.
